name: Auto Rotate Lite
description: Adds an image-style effect that auto-rotates JPEG/TIFF derivatives according to their EXIF orientation flag, using only Drupal core and the GD toolkit.
project_description: Auto Rotate Lite provides an additional image effect that can be added to image styles to automatically correct image rotation according to the image's EXIF orientation information using the GD toolkit. It relies only on Drupal core and GD (plus PHP's exif extension), making it a lighter alternative to the full Image Effects suite. Unlike the EXIF Orientation module it does not modify the original upload; the correction is applied only when the corresponding image style derivative is generated.
